purpose: Evaluate frozen cross-zone selection when source outcomes and all fitted settings precede target evaluation.
data_origin: Current authoritative 60/20/20 forecast/candidate experiment; no use of 20260917 alternate-split candidate datasets.
cutoff_rule: ceil_UTC_day(max first original-test issue across all 600 streams)) + 28 days
source_rule: Original test issues < cutoff, label_timestamp < cutoff, feedback_available_timestamp <= cutoff; exclude outer held-out zone.
target_rule: Original test issues >= cutoff; identical eligible event set for all nine methods within each stream.
fit_width_and_statistics: Only source-prefix data; 33/67 percentiles re-estimated per outer fold and seed.
fit_support_and_shrinkage: Recompute original adaptive n_min and nu rules from source-prefix sufficient statistics.
fit_TSC: Re-select original 19-configuration family using source-prefix data, excluding outer (and inner validation zones where applicable); replay causal endpoints with original calibration initialization.
fit_Cart_LinUCB: Repeat existing source-zone tuning within source-prefix; LinUCB retains zero initialization and selected-action delayed feedback.

fixed_algorithm_constants.guardrails: Original fixed five-price rule; no outcome-driven change during this check

policy_evaluation: CLARA and CART frozen after prefix fitting. Standalone adaptive calibrators and g keep causal histories. LinUCB updates chosen actions during target replay.
metrics: Single-forecast ERRF, TUWR, coverage, width, interval score, ARD, TOWR and one-sided rolling gaps; 168 hourly point evaluation windows wholly within post-cutoff period.
aggregation: Pool seed numerators/denominators within zone/price/predictor/horizon/coverage, then equal-weight conditions and zones.
inference: Paired zone bootstrap on common post-cutoff evaluation; compare all baseline methods, not only best-looking contrast.
scope: A retrospective temporal-information sensitivity check using a prespecified cutoff; historical algorithm development is not an untouched prospective trial.
preservation: No source artifacts, old paused rerun directory, published release, manuscript or supplementary Word file is overwritten.
